         ssh_user):

            running_instance,
            ssh_private_key,
            ssh_user,
        )
        # TODO: print results
        sys.exit(status)
    except Exception as e:
        click.secho(
            "{}: {}".format(type(e).__name__, e),
            fg='red'
        )
        sys.exit(1)
